## Historical audit: H0034

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_integration_02/codex_integration_02_I_r1/infer_logs/kea-atomic-signal-selectors/turn_1/trajs.json`. Event references below are to this file’s main agent; offsets identify the supplied decoded observations.

| Aspect | Evidence and assessment |
|---|---|
| Goal | The student calls the task the “Atomic Signal Selector Engine” and says it was asked to branch from `main`. The full original specification is not visible. The attempted reproduction suggests an inferred goal of avoiding recomputation after an unrelated nested update; it is not proof of the complete intended behavior. [event 29, chars 0–1306; event 31, chars 0–1082] |
| Autonomous exploration | The student inspected branches, scripts, selector construction, reducers, React hooks, mounting, build and context code, types, and existing tests. The inspected reducer code creates a Reselect selector from `logic.selector` and extracts `state[key]`; derived selectors also use `createSelector`. These are observed code structures, not a runtime diagnosis. [events 4, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 20, 22, 24, 26, 28] |
| Changes | With no local `main` or configured remote shown, the student created `atomic-signal-selectors` from `master`, at the original checkout commit. The student reported no source changes or commit; the supplied inventory records a zero-byte patch. [events 4–6; event 31, chars 0–1082; H0034 inventory metadata] |
| Validation | A Node reproduction intended to count selector evaluations and inspect `selectorHealth` failed before execution because `@babel/register` could not be found. No build or tests were run, according to the final report. [events 29–31] |
| Teacher input | The inventory lists available hint files, but availability is not receipt. No delivered teacher text or adoption appears in the supplied events; metadata records zero teacher checks. The actual system-prompt file is linked but its contents are not supplied here. [top-level metadata, chars 0–5079; H0034 inventory metadata] |
| Outcome | **Empty patch; implementation incomplete; formal evaluation missing.** The session’s `success`/`end_turn` metadata describes termination, not task success. The failed reproduction is a technical obstacle to validation, not evidence that an implemented algorithm failed. [top-level metadata, chars 0–5079; event 30, chars 0–1955; event 31, chars 0–1082; inventory metadata] |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, distinguish a failed test harness from a failing behavioral test, and a completed session from a completed task. Task-specific observations are the existing Reselect construction and missing Babel registration module. Whether nested changes actually cause unwanted recomputation, what the full contract required, and whether any approach would satisfy it remain unresolved; no runtime result or formal correctness evidence is available. This is a code task, not a scene audit.
